title: Transition-Zone Seed Re-initialization with Damped Optimization
scientific_hypothesis: Compressing layers 1-3 to 40-60 nm and expanding layers 5-8 to 100-140 nm will sharpen the spectral roll-off between UV reflection (200-400 nm) and SWIR transmission (800-1500 nm) bands, improving dual-band separation compared to uniform 100 nm initialization.
design_principle: Targeted thickness seed perturbation in the spectral transition zone (layers controlling the 400-800 nm transition region) combined with reduced optimizer step size to dampen oscillations around the current configuration.
proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating stack: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica substrate
design_variables: Thickness bounds: layers 1-3: 40-60 nm, layers 5-8: 100-140 nm, remaining layers: 30-200 nm
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 800-1500 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 200-400 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Absolute thickness tolerance ±15 nm for robustness analysis
theory_basis: Feedback directive specifies transition-zone focused re-initialization to sharpen spectral roll-off
Non-quarter-wave optimization allows finer spectral control than fixed quarter-wave stacks
expected_advantages: Sharper spectral transition between UV rejection and SWIR transmission bands
Reduced optimizer oscillation due to 20% step size reduction
Better exploitation of iteration_05 configuration knowledge
known_risks: Overly narrow seed ranges may trap optimizer in local minimum
Layer 4 boundary effects between compressed and expanded regions may create unintended interference
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate for dual-band performance. Incidence: air, normal angle, unpolarized. Materials: HfO2 (high-index), SiO2 (low-index). Layer sequence: HfO2/SiO2 alternating, starting with HfO2. Thickness bounds: layers 1-3: 40-60 nm, layers 5-8: 100-140 nm, layers 4 and 9-24: 30-200 nm. Initialize with perturbed seeds in specified ranges. Objectives: maximize mean transmittance 800-1500 nm, maximize mean reflectance 200-400 nm. Optimizer: gradient_thickness with step size reduced 20% from baseline. Robustness: ±15 nm absolute normal deviation. Total layer count fixed at 24. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 200-400 nm, 800-1500 nm. soft objectives: High transmission in 800-1500 nm band; High reflection in 200-400 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low transmission in 200-400 nm band; Low reflection in 800-1500 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layers <= 30; Materials limited to HfO2 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Direct implementation of feedback directive: re-initialize population with perturbed thickness seeds focused on spectral transition zone (compress layers 1-3 to 40-60 nm, expand layers 5-8 to 100-140 nm), reduce optimizer step size by 20% to dampen oscillations.
